_instructions.purpose: Template for human expert review of LLM-verified extraction JSONs. The Verified_*.json files serve as a triage tool — review items flagged as unsupported first, then spot-check supported items.
workflow: 1. Open the Verified_*.json file and the corresponding source PDF side by side
2. Review all items where _llm_flag.is_supported = false (these are the ones most likely to need correction)
3. For each flagged item, check the source PDF and record your judgment
4. Spot-check 3-5 items where _llm_flag.is_supported = true (to catch false positives)
5. Record any extraction errors the LLM verifier missed entirely
6. Fill in the summary fields at the bottom
_instructions.time_tracking: Record start and end times to measure time savings from LLM triage

entity_reviews._comment: Copy one entry per reviewed entity. Focus on _llm_flag.is_supported=false items first.
entity_reviews.extracted_value: The value from the extraction JSON
entity_reviews.correction: If incorrect, what should the value be?
entity_reviews.page_reference: Page/Table/Figure in the PDF where you found the evidence

missed_errors._comment: Extraction errors NOT caught by the LLM verifier (items marked supported that are actually wrong)

missing_extractions._comment: Important information in the paper that was NOT extracted at all
